_comment: The Astra dimension. Each entry in 'biomes' is one biome + the climate where it appears.
Land = Astra Fields, deep water areas (continentalness below -0.19, same as vanilla oceans) = Astra Ocean.
A parameter can be one number or a range [min, max] (-1 to 1, continentalness goes a bit below -1).
To add a new biome: create it in worldgen/biome/ (copy astra_biome.json) and add an entry here
Biomes whose parameters are closer together appear next to each other.
Sky look (End sky, no sun) is set in dimension_type/astra_dim_type.json -> 'effects'.
